Tigress involved in human kill captured in Bandhavgarh

A tigress that had killed and consumed a human in Bandhavgarh National Park has been captured. The operation involved approximately 50 forest personnel and four elephants. The tigress has been placed in a two-month confinement. Separately, another tiger died in Uttar Pradesh a few hours after its last human attack, causing fear among local villagers.
